class.name: RayCast3DDirect
class.brief_description: A ray in 3D space, used to find the first object it intersects.
class.description: A ray in 3D space, used to find the first object it intersects. Unlike its sibling, [RayCast3D], this is not a [Node] and does not go into the scene tree. Instead, you must provide the [RID] for the physics space to query yourself, and then manually invoke the cast. This can be done statically, or through an instance, and provides its results in a [RayCastResult].
